name: Genome ~Shinka no Idenshi o Sagase~
source:
Main character is the third year student of agriculture faculty. General education process ends, and it is finally time to enter the laboratory. Under guidance of the laboratory adviser he will need to repeat genetic research with partners from the same laboratory to create new life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是农学系三年级学生。通识教育阶段已经结束，他终于要进入研究室。在导师指导下，他将与研究室伙伴反复进行遗传学研究，尝试创造新的生命。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
